sn35.65:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2-3
sn35.65:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Samiddhi yena Bhagavā || pa ||
sn35.65:1.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante Māro vā assa Mārapaññatti vā ti || || 4
sn35.65:2.1: Yattha kho Samiddhi atthi cakkhum atthi rūpā atthi cakkhuviññāṇam atthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || atthi tattha Māro vā Mārapaññatti vā || || 5-6
sn35.65:2.4: jivhā atthi rasā atthi jivhāviññāṇam atthi jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || atthi tattha Māro vā Mārapaññatti vā || ||
sn35.65:2.6: Atthi mano atthi dhammā atthi manoviññāṇam atthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || atthi tattha Māro vā Mārapaññatti vā || || 10-12
sn35.65:3.1: Yattha ca kho Samiddhi natthi cakkhu natthi rūpā natthi cakkhuviññāṇaṃ natthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || natthi tattha Māro vā Mārapaññatti vā ||
sn35.65:3.4: Natthi jivhā natthi rasā natthi jivhāviññāṇaṃ natthi jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā || natthi tattha Māro vā Mārapaññatti vā ||
